advice.speaker: doctor
lines: All done. Keep it clean and come back if it goes green.
You'll live. Probably. Drink some water.

options.text: That hurt more than the injury did.

welcome.speaker: doctor
lines: Don't mention it. Really, don't. I'll have queues.
Any time. Well, not any time. Try to space it out.

live.speaker: doctor
lines: We all die eventually. Just not today, and not on my shift.
Today, yes. After that, it's up to you.

hurt.speaker: doctor
lines: It was supposed to. That's how you know it's working.
Next time get hurt somewhere less awkward.
